items.raw_excerpt: Wellington region residents say they've been handed "ridiculous" and "unreasonable" water bills for basement car parks and granny flats.
items.summary_en: People in the Wellington region say they got huge water bills for basement car parks and granny flats. They call the bills 'ridiculous' and 'unreasonable'.

items.title_en: Wellington residents angry over 'ridiculous' water bills for car parks and granny flats

items.title_original: Wellington residents shocked by 'ridiculous' water bills for car parks, granny flats

items.raw_excerpt: The summer holidays are important everywhere, but Italy takes the traditional shutdown particularly seriously.
items.summary_en: August is a special month in Italy. The whole country takes a big summer break, and many shops and offices close for weeks. These are seven signs that show the August shutdown has begun.
items.summary_ko: 8월은 이탈리아에서 특별한 달입니다. 나라 전체가 여름 휴가에 들어가 많은 가게와 사무실이 몇 주 동안 문을 닫습니다. 이탈리아의 8월 휴가가 시작됐다는 일곱 가지 신호를 소개합니다.
items.title_en: 7 signs that August has arrived in Italy

items.raw_excerpt: Train services between The Hague and Delft were suspended on Monday after a dog ran onto the track. The disruptions began at 8am when a train had to stop to avoid hitting the animal. All main line services have been cancelled until at least 10.30am, including Intercity trains from Hollands Spoor station to Breda and Sprinter trains between The Hague and Dordrecht. Trams between The Hague and Delft are running as normal. Passengers are advised to check the NS travel...
items.summary_en: Train services between The Hague and Delft were stopped on Monday because a dog ran onto the track. A train had to stop in the morning to avoid hitting the animal. Services were cancelled until at least 10.30am, but trams kept running as normal.
items.summary_ko: 월요일 개 한 마리가 선로에 들어가는 바람에 헤이그와 델프트 사이 열차 운행이 중단됐습니다. 기차 한 대가 동물을 피하기 위해 급정차하면서 오전 8시부터 운행에 차질이 빚어졌습니다. 인터시티와 스프린터 열차가 최소 오전 10시 30분까지 취소됐지만 트램은 정상 운행했습니다.
items.title_en: Trains cancelled after dog runs on to track near The Hague

items.raw_excerpt: Controversial Dunedin city councillor Benedict Ong has been kicked out of a council meeting to discuss amalgamation plans and has been asked to leave two public events in the past week.

items.raw_excerpt: How temperature changes not just what we eat, but everything about the way we eat it

items.raw_excerpt: As a wildfire closed in, residents of the town of El Tiemblo grabbed shovels and rakes to defend an elder -- "El Abuelo," a centuries-old chestnut tree, one of Spain's most treasured.
items.summary_en: A wildfire came close to the town of El Tiemblo. Locals used shovels and rakes to protect a centuries-old chestnut tree named 'El Abuelo.' The tree is one of Spain's most treasured trees.
items.summary_ko: 산불이 마을에 다가오자 주민들은 삽과 갈퀴를 들고 나섰다. 그들이 지키려는 것은 수백 년 된 밤나무 '엘 아부엘로'였다. 이 나무는 스페인에서 가장 소중하게 여겨지는 나무 중 하나다.
items.title_en: Residents protect Spain's old chestnut tree 'El Abuelo' from fire

items.raw_excerpt: Taipei will expand its weekly free milk program to include junior high school students beginning with the new school year on Aug. 31, the city's Department of Education announced Monday.
items.summary_en: Taipei will expand its weekly free milk program to junior high school students. The new plan starts with the school year on Aug. 31. The city's education department made the announcement on Monday.

items.raw_excerpt: SALZBURG24 präsentiert Fotos von den besten Events im Bundesland Salzburg. Wir sind bei Festivals, Messen, Konzerten und vielen weiteren Veranstaltungen live vor Ort.
